[EVENT] User is having issues with their computer desk and is looking for cable management ideas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested cable management ideas:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Cable Ties and Zip Ties: Use to bundle cables together.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cable Management Strips: Adhesive-backed strips for routing cables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Cable Organizers and Trays: Desk-top trays or boxes for storing cables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Cable Clips: Clips to attach cables to desk or wall.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Desk Grommets: Holes in the desk for routing cables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Cable Management Boxes: Enclosed boxes for managing cables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Labeling: Use labels to identify cables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Route Cables Behind the Desk: Keep cables out of the way.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Use a Cable Management Panel: Mounted panel for organizing cables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Cable Management Accessories: Organizers, concealers, or hiders.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Keep Frequently Used Cables Accessible: Store them in an easy-to-reach location.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Consider a Standing Desk with Built-in Cable Management: For a new desk.
